name: 8-Team 0.5 PPR Keeper League
//opponent_keepers: A keeper costs the round that player was drafted in last year, so the pick it
burns varies per player. `keepers.py` ranks who is most likely kept by surplus.
Fill `known` with real names as you learn them; `unknown_count` is how many of
the other seven teams you expect to keep somebody.
//schedule: Fantasy regular season is weeks 1-14; the 6-team bracket runs 15-16-17 with
byes for the top two seeds. Week 17 ends Monday 2027-01-04, which matches the
league's stated playoff end date. NFL week 18 is not used.
